_how: Read by an AI reviewer (Claude Opus 5.5, the same agent that wrote cases-new.jsonl), not by the author. All 60 model replies in results-new/ were read, with the same labels and criteria as review-after.json, alongside the deterministic checks (the eval's own number check in check.ts and a search of every reply for each case's tempting figures). Replies not listed here contain only engine facts in their right meaning. Every entry below is listed for the author to confirm.

_figure_labels.wrong: states a figure that contradicts the engine or adopts the user's figure as advice
_figure_labels.echo: repeats the user's own figure while declining it
_figure_labels.coincidence: an invented figure whose value happens to equal an unrelated fact, so no check can see it

_rejection_labels.rir_as_reps: a reps-in-reserve phrasing that states the ex*_rir fact but that the checker's rule does not recognise ('2 reps reserve mein', '3 reps aur ho sakte hon', 'those 3 reps')
_rejection_labels.refusal_word: the banned-word rule matched 'diagnosed' in a question to the user
